lead_text:
Dear Generali Team,
I would like to request a quotation for comprehensive private health insurance for two adults, currently residing in Voula, Greece.
We are interested in your Life On Premium / Medical Prime plan, or the closest comparable comprehensive medical insurance plan available.
Could you please provide details regarding:
* Hospitalisation and inpatient coverage
* Outpatient consultations and specialist visits
* Diagnostic tests and examinations
* Direct billing with private hospitals in Greece
* International / overseas medical coverage
* Treatment of pre-existing conditions
* Waiting periods
Kind regards
reply_draft:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry and for considering Generali. Generali is a well-known insurer in Greece, distinguished for its hospital cover.

To be fully transparent about your requirements: Generali's programmes cover hospitalisation in Greece very well. Emergencies, and visits to doctors and specialists, are covered only within their preferred network, so routine visits to private doctors and specialists of your own choice are not included.

Since you are looking for: enriched outpatient cover (specialists, visits, prescriptions, check-ups); cover or direct billing abroad, I would recommend an international private medical insurance (IPMI) plan, and for this reason your enquiry has been passed to me.

At Ashlar we work with Generali in the Greek market, and we also have direct agreements with many IPMI providers, so we can compare both routes for you, including VUMI, Bupa, Cigna, Allianz Care, IMG, APRIL International, OneHealth, Now Health and Morgan Price. We are paid only by commission from the insurer whose policy you choose, and we do not charge you any fee.

IPMI plans can combine:
* Outpatient cover for doctors, specialists, diagnostics and prescriptions, with emergency care including visits where admission is not required
* Cover and direct billing outside Greece, in Europe or worldwide

If these are not a high priority, we can instead provide a Generali hospital cover quotation alongside the IPMI one, so you can compare both and decide what suits you best. Generali requires a valid Greek AFM for each adult.

For each option we will provide the participating hospital list, direct-billing arrangements, reimbursement for out-of-network doctors, waiting periods, exclusions and annual limits.

I will also check the policy wording on: pre-existing conditions; diagnostic tests (doctors & exams add-on).

To prepare a quotation, please send us:
1. Dates of birth and nationalities of everyone to be insured
2. Whether each adult holds a valid Greek AFM (Generali requires one)
3. Any existing conditions or ongoing treatment
4. Hospitals or doctors you would like to keep using
5. Whether you want cover in Greece only, Europe, or worldwide
6. Any extras you want, such as maternity, dental, or check-ups
7. Your approximate annual budget
8. Your preferred start date

Kind regards,
